title: Mexican Cod Ceviche
description: A refreshing Mexican dish made with cod, lime juice, and spices.
instructions: Cut the cod fillets into small pieces and place them in a shallow dish.
Squeeze the fresh lime juice over the cod, making sure each piece is coated.
Add the chopped red onion, cilantro, and minced jalapeño pepper to the dish.
Season with a pinch of salt and mix well.
Cover the dish with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, garnish with additional cilantro if desired.
Serve chilled, with tortilla chips or tostadas on the side.
